After acquiring a 1H NMR spectrum, you find that the resolution is poor due to significant overlap of signals in the aliphatic region. Which of the following experiments would be most helpful in resolving this issue?

A. 1D 1H-1H nOe
B. 1H-13C HMBC
C. 1H-13C HSQC
D. 1H-1H COSY
